topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: These opening remarks introduce the structure of the lecture series, the interdisciplinary audience, and the session's core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Cancer as Disrupted Differentiation and Tissue Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics conceptualize cancer development as a failure of normal developmental programming, cellular differentiation, and tissue architecture driven by genetic and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Progression, Invasion, and Classification of Benign and Malignant Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the distinction between benign and malignant tumors through tissue invasion, metastatic pathways, stepwise progression, and standard pathological nomenclature.

topics.label: Pathology, Mortality, and Comparative Incidence of Cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the physiological mechanisms by which tumors cause illness and compare patterns of cancer incidence and mortality across human tissues and multicellular animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical Detection and Cancer Screening Modalities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the principles, histological basis, and practical efficacy of clinical screening programs across different anatomical cancer sites.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Briefing
topics.groupedBecause: These closing remarks conclude the session by referencing the learning outcomes and setting expectations for upcoming practical sessions and lectures.
